{
  "rules": [
    "If sentiment is consistently low (≤0.05) over recent days, reduce forecast slope to avoid over-optimism.",
    "If forecast shows strong upward trend after a recent spike, apply downward correction to prevent overshoot.",
    "When true outcome shows sharp downward movement after a high, model should adjust downward faster than linear trend.",
    "If model forecast is consistently above true outcome by >5% over 3-5 days, consider mean reversion bias and reduce forecast slope.",
    "If sentiment history shows increasing positive sentiment (e.g., 0.20+), model should not over-forecast unless accompanied by strong historical momentum.",
    "For 30-day horizon, if true outcome deviates >10% from forecast in first 5 days, adjust forecast to align with recent mean or volatility pattern.",
    "If sentiment is high (≥0.20) and forecast is flat or declining, consider upward bias correction to reflect sentiment-driven momentum.",
    "When true outcome shows strong upward movement after a low, model should not lag — adjust forecast to match early trend reversal."
  ]
}
